question: Which devotion needs nothing, and which depends on karma?
premises: regardless, in Shiva, devotion — grace-descent of fruit-seekers
depends on karma and the rest
inference: Regard-free Shiva-devotion descends; fruit-desired devotion needs karma.
plain_english: Regardless, in Shiva devotion — grace-descent of fruit-seekers; which by fruit-desire, devotion depends on karma and the rest.
